summary: Prakash Anant benchmarks Claude Opus 5.5 alongside Gemini 4 Argon, GPT 6 Astra, and Kimi K3 to build an animated 3D whale breaching scene in the ocean.

post.originalText:
4 Argon vs Opus 5.5 vs GPT 6 Astra vs Kimi K3  

I asked all four to build a 3D whale breaching scene.  

Argon's level of detail is on another level, and it wins on photorealism. Opus and Kimi look more realistic than Astra.  

But what a comeback from Google!! https://t.co/wmD9b9STli
